meanings.note: directional compound verb moving out away from the speaker

examples.trans: He just stepped out to take a phone call.

examples.trans: I just heard her making a phone call — she is going to betray Director Chun Yu!

examples.text: 我已经跟抢救的医生谈过了。

examples.text: 海外华人也很喜欢这个节目。

examples.trans: There is so much work at the company.

examples.trans: Sooner or later you will grow; you need to have confidence in yourself.

examples.trans: Xiaogu, I am so sorry — I got your notebook all dirty.

examples.text: 以后有什么不懂的地方，来找我。
examples.trans: From now on, if there is anything you do not understand, come find me.

examples.text: 王老师正在办公室里找你。
examples.trans: Teacher Wang is looking for you in the office right now.
